column1: # Gate bypass corpus. Tab-separated: mode, command (with \n escapes), expected verdict.
# mode: both | disarmed | armed. verdict: allow | deny.
# Golden = behavior of approval-gate.sh as of 2026-09-18, reviewed case by case.
# Every regression fix in the gate's comments has a case here; add new bypasses here first.
# git push is on the Claude disarmed allowlist (shipping stays armed-or-not). The
# OMP gate additionally pipeline-gates it; that layer is not this corpus's concern.
# --- mutating git: denied by the orchestrator scan in every mode ---
# reads through global options; --git-dir=<path> log is a read of another checkout
# --- interpreters: the interpreter itself is refused, every form ---
# --- path-checked movers: scratch (/tmp) ok when armed, never when disarmed ---
# every path argument must be in scratch, sources included (fail closed)
# prefix words only prefix the real command
# the disarmed pre-check refuses every '>' that survives stderr-stripping, /dev/null included
# process substitution splits into scanned segments; the fd it makes writes nothing
# --- compounds, heredocs, newlines: every segment is examined ---
# --- build tools: not reads; denied disarmed, allowed armed (blast-radius call) ---
